capabilities: Chat with the vault through a streaming, tool-using agent
Suggest inline AI completions and selection actions while editing
Save web pages and video transcripts as clean Markdown notes
Compile chosen folders into structured, searchable wiki articles
Store and recall durable memory records across sessions
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-by-staff notice. The README warns that all note content is sent to the configured provider with no local-only mode, that API keys are stored unencrypted in data.json, and points deeper docs to CLAUDE.md and docs/architecture/. Works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so querying, editing, and building on notes with a language model requires stitching together separate tools.

relations.evidence: only to the provider endpoint you set up yourself (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Anthropic

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Anthropic, or OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

summary: AI workbench that chats with your vault, writes inline completions, captures web and video content, and compiles notes into a searchable wiki.
